description: This file defines the CustomerAttributeService interface, which declares methods for managing customer attribute entities such as saving, updating, and retrieving by various identifiers within a sales management system.

classes.name: CustomerAttributeService
classes.description: Interface for customer attribute management operations, extending a generic entity service.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Persists a new customer attribute or updates an existing one, may throw a ServiceException.

methods.name: getByCustomerOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerAttribute based on merchant store, customer ID, and attribute ID.

methods.name: getByCustomerOptionValueId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerAttributes based on merchant store and attribute value ID.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerAttributes based on merchant store and option ID.

methods.name: getByCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves all CustomerAttributes associated with a specific customer in a merchant store.

search-terms: retrieving customer attributes by various IDs
